scope: EXT-D-0093 known missing Web Locks recovery in the Settings audit key card
root_cause: The audit key primitive rejected missing navigator.locks before storage access with an ordinary Error. Settings treated that error as a retryable rotation or clipboard failure, inviting another mutation although the browser context could not lock storage.
repair: The primitive now throws DeviceKeyLockUnavailableError without weakening its exclusive origin lock. Details load, export, and rotation show one specific capability error, clear stale details, and block Re-key and export until a successful details-only read. Unknown active-key outcomes retain their separate re-key block; ordinary failures retain their existing retry paths.
